note: Hand-assembled from the sources below and change-checked member by member. Unlike MN-2 there is no machine reconciliation here: 18 seats across two cities, from two different publishers, with no third-party roster (Open States does not cover municipal councils).

sources.duluth_gis: City of Duluth GIS Office, VotingDistricts/MapServer/16 'Districts and City Councilors' - carries the sitting councilor's name per district
sources.duluth_council: https://duluthmn.gov/city-council/ and the nine individual councilor pages under /city-council/city-councilors/
sources.duluth_charter: Duluth City Charter ch. II 'Elective Officers' ss 2-5; ch. VI s 38
sources.stpaul_gis: City of Saint Paul, Council_Ward_/FeatureServer/0 'Council Ward' - carries the sitting councilmember's name, email and phone per ward
sources.stpaul_charter: Saint Paul City Charter - a mayor at large and seven councilmembers, one per ward, four-year terms

change_check.method: All 18 members' own pages fetched and scanned; see sweep-member-pages.mjs and read-duluth-terms.mjs.
change_check.language_scanner_verdict: BLIND TO THE ACTUAL DEFECT. The word scanner found one benign biographical line in 18 pages. The real signal was a DATE IN THE PAST on four pages, which no wording flagged.

roster.title: Councilor
roster.predecessor_note: Mike Mayou resigned end of June 2025 on moving out of the district; Deborah DeLuca was appointed interim by unanimous council vote and served until the first Monday in January, as ch. II s 4 requires. Desotelle won the November 2025 general with 80%. The INTERIM holder is not modelled: this wave seats who holds the seat today.

roster.title: Councilor
roster.predecessor_note: District 4 appears in BOTH the 2023 and 2025 election listings, which looked like a contradiction until it was read: Renee Van Nett left the seat, Tara Swenson won a special election to the unexpired PARTIAL term, and Clanaugh defeated Swenson in the November 2025 general, 53% to 46%.

roster.title: Councilor, At Large
roster.page_date_note: STALE. The page states a term that expired 2026-01-05. Forsman won an at-large seat in November 2023, so his term runs to 2028-01-03. All four at-large pages carry the same expired date; the two 2023 winners and the two 2025 winners alike.

roster.title: Councilor, At Large
roster.page_date_note: STALE, same as Forsman. Nephew won an at-large seat in November 2023.

roster.title: Councilor, At Large
roster.page_date_note: STALE. Tomanek was RE-ELECTED at large in November 2025 with 10,504 votes, so her current term runs to 2030-01-07. Her page states the date her PREVIOUS term expired.

roster.title: Councilor, At Large
roster.page_date_note: STALE. Johnson is a NEWCOMER elected at large in November 2025 with 8,515 votes; his term began 2026-01-05 and runs to 2030-01-07. His page states an expiry that predates his own term.

roster.title: Mayor
roster.page_date_note: The mayor's page states only 'his term began in January 2024' and gives no day. 2024-01-01 is the first Monday in January 2024, which is the boundary the charter uses (ch. II s 4) and which the three district councilors elected alongside him confirm by stating an expiry of 2028-01-03.

roster.title: Councilmember
roster.predecessor_note: Council President Mitra Jalali announced her resignation in January 2025 citing health, effective 2025-03-08. Coleman won the SPECIAL ELECTION of 2025-08-12 with 52.36% and was sworn in 2025-08-27. The council index page's blanket line 'Councilmembers were elected to a 4-year term in 2023' is therefore WRONG FOR THIS SEAT -- another reason a list page is not a change-check. Old sub-pages still sit under /ward-4-councilmember-mitra-jalali/.

roster.title: Councilmember
roster.page_note: Her page says she was 'sworn into the Saint Paul City Council in January 2020'. That is her FIRST term, not the current one; she began a second term with the rest of the 2024 council.

roster.title: Councilmember
roster.page_note: Ward 7's URL is /ward-7-cheniqua-johnson, not /ward-7. The guessed /ward-7 returns a 404 whose 110 KB body mentions 'Johnson' twice, so a surname-only identity test PASSES on it. Status is checked before content.

roster.title: Mayor
roster.note: 56th Mayor of Saint Paul; the city's first woman, first Asian American and first Hmong American mayor. She defeated the incumbent Melvin Carter on 2025-11-04 and was sworn in 2026-01-02. She is the SAME PERSON the Minnesota House's Leadership tab still lists for HD-64A, which is what MN-2 found and could not explain from House sources alone.
